about_the_game:
🅿️ Parking Tycoon 2

Return to the world of parking business! In Parking Tycoon 2, you're not only building and expanding your empire — you're personally defending it from thieves. A brand-new combat system, skill progression, and hireable guards turn your parking lot into a true fortress!

Upgrade Your Management Skills

As the owner of a parking business, you'll once again start with an empty plot of land — but now with even more tools to turn it into a thriving empire. Build new lots, upgrade equipment, install surveillance systems, and manage your staff — from cashiers to professional security guards.

Choose your own strategy: maximize profits, expand your territory, ensure customer safety, and dominate the industry. Investments, layout, technology — you're in full control.

Business Under Threat? Defend It Yourself

The key innovation in Parking Tycoon 2 is its active combat system. You can now confront thieves head-on as they attempt to raid your property. Use punches, blocks, and dodges, apply tactics, and develop your character’s combat skills.

Hire guards, each with unique stats and abilities. Level them up, build your team, and make sure no criminal walks away unpunished. Security is no longer just for show — it’s a crucial part of your gameplay strategy.

Deep Management & Mystery

Running a parking lot involves more than lines and payments. Deal with breakdowns, unstable weather, and sometimes even unexplained events. The land you’re building on still holds secrets. Explore it, unlock new zones, and discover why you were the one chosen to bring order.

Become a Parking Legend

Keep customer satisfaction high, optimize pricing, manage traffic flow, and build your reputation. The mix of business simulation, resource management, and action creates a unique experience where every detail matters.

🅿️ Build. Manage. Defend. Welcome to Parking Tycoon 2.
